requirements.text: Each Business Day the system must value every FLEX Option position (purchased calls/puts and written calls/puts) at the exchange model-based price provided at the official close, and compute net assets and NAV per share as of the close of regular NYSE trading (ordinarily 4:00 p.m. ET).
requirements.quote: FLEX Options listed on an exchange will typically be valued at a model-based price provided by the exchange at the official close of that exchange’s trading day.

requirements.text: For a FLEX Option that has a same-day market trading price, the system must use that same-day trade price instead of the exchange model-based price for that day's valuation.
requirements.quote: However, when the Fund’s option has a same-day market trading price, this same-day market trading price will be used for FLEX Option values instead of the exchange’s model-based price.

requirements.text: If the exchange cannot provide a model price, the system must use the backup third-party pricing provider's model price; if neither vendor is available, use the Valuation Designee's price per the Valuation Procedures.
requirements.quote: If the exchange on which the option is traded is unable to provide a model price, model-based FLEX Options prices will additionally be provided by a backup third-party pricing provider. If either pricing vendor is not available... the value of a FLEX option will be determined by Innovator as Valuation Designee in accordance with the Valuation Procedures.

requirements.text: Where in the same trading day a FLEX Option appears in an all-cash basket and in an in-kind basket, the system must value that option for the whole day at the trade price for both instances rather than the model price.
requirements.quote: for valuation purposes that trading day the Fund will default to use the trade price for both instances, rather than the model price otherwise available for the in-kind transaction.

requirements.text: The system must carry purchased options as assets recorded at premium paid and marked to current value; written options must be carried as a liability recorded at premium received and marked to current value.
requirements.quote: When the Funds purchase an option, an amount equal to the premium paid... are recorded as an investment and is subsequently adjusted to the current value... When the Funds write an option, an amount equal to the premium received... are recorded as a liability and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option written.

requirements.text: The system must value each option position as price per share x 100 shares per contract x number of contracts (purchased positive, written negative).
requirements.assumption_or_question: The multiplier of 100 from the financial-statement footnote applies to these FLEX Options; scenario option prices are quoted per share.

requirements.text: The system must accrue the unitary management fee daily at an annual rate of 0.79% of net assets and reduce net assets by the accrued, unpaid fee.
requirements.quote: the Fund has agreed to pay an annual unitary management fee to Innovator in an amount equal to 0.79% of its average daily net assets.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Daily accrual = net assets x 0.0079 / day-count; the applicable day-count convention (e.g. 360, 365, actual) must be confirmed.

requirements.text: The day-count basis for accruing the daily management fee and the deposit-account interest must be confirmed (calendar days vs. 360/365 and whether weekend days accrue).
requirements.assumption_or_question: Ask the client/administrator: what day-count convention is used for the fee and for deposit interest, and does accrual run over weekends? Scenarios assume a 365-day year with calendar-day accrual over weekends unless stated.

requirements.text: The system must accrue interest daily on the U.S. Bank Money Market Deposit Account at the variable rate in effect and include accrued interest in net assets.
requirements.quote: The MMDA will bear interest at a variable rate that is determined based on market conditions and is subject to change daily.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Interest = cash x rate / day-count; day-count per Q8.

requirements.text: The system must record investment transactions on trade date and compute realized gain/loss on options using identified cost.
requirements.quote: Investment transactions are recorded on the trade date. The Trust determines the gain or loss realized from investment transactions on the basis of identified cost.

requirements.text: On a closing purchase of a written option, the system must realize gain/loss as premium received less amount paid (including brokerage commissions), and reduce the remaining recorded premium by the identified-cost portion of the contracts closed.
requirements.quote: The difference between the premium and the amount paid on effecting a closing purchase transaction, including brokerage commissions, is also treated as a realized gain, or if the premium is less than the amount paid for the closing purchase transaction, as a realized loss.

requirements.text: On a sale (closing) of a purchased option, the system must realize gain/loss as proceeds less identified cost of the contracts sold and reduce remaining recorded cost accordingly.
requirements.quote: If the Funds enter into a closing sale transaction, a gain or loss is realized.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Identified cost for a position built in multiple lots must be applied; the lot-identification method (e.g. average vs. specific lot) must be confirmed where lots differ in price. Scenarios use average cost of the position.

requirements.text: At expiration the system must cash-settle each option: the holder/writer receives or owes (reference closing price - strike) x multiplier x contracts, floored at zero intrinsic value for each option, and realize the resulting gain/loss against recorded premium/cost.
requirements.quote: Cash-settled option contracts give the holder the right to receive an amount (or owe an amount) of cash upon the exercise... equal to the difference between the closing price of the Reference Asset’s price return and the exercise price of the option contract times a specified multiple (“multiplier”)... Option contracts that expire unexercised have no value.

requirements.text: At conclusion of the Outcome Period the system must collect the cash value of all expiring FLEX Options and set up the new series at their opening premiums.
requirements.quote: Upon conclusion of the Outcome Period, the Fund will receive the cash value of all the FLEX Options it held for the prior Outcome Period. It will then invest in a new series of FLEX Options...

requirements.text: The system must compute NAV per share as (total assets including accrued income less all liabilities, including the written-option liability and accrued fee) divided by shares outstanding, rounded to the nearest cent.
requirements.quote: calculated by taking the market price of the Fund’s total assets, including any interest or dividends accrued but not yet collected, less all liabilities, and dividing such amount by the total number of Shares outstanding. The result, rounded to the nearest cent is the NAV per Share.

requirements.text: On creation/redemption orders received by Closing Time, the system must strike the order at that day's NAV, settle T+1, compute the Cash Component/Cash Redemption Amount as the difference between NAV per Creation Unit and the aggregate market value of delivered instruments, and apply the transaction fee per order.
requirements.quote: The Cash Component is an amount equal to the difference between the NAV of a Fund’s shares (per Creation Unit) and the Deposit Amount... A transaction fee is applicable to each transaction regardless of the number of units.

requirements.text: On an in-kind basket the system must deliver a pro-rata number of contracts of each position per creation unit; where the pro-rata share is not a whole number of contracts, it must round and settle the deviation in the cash component.
requirements.quote: A pro-rata basket is a basket that is a pro rata representation of the ETF’s portfolio holdings. When utilizing a pro-rata basket, minor deviations may occur when it is not operationally feasible to include a particular instrument within the basket.
requirements.assumption_or_question: The rounding rule (round down to whole contracts) and that the residual is carried in cash must be confirmed; scenarios round down to whole contracts.

requirements.text: On an in-kind redemption/creation the system must record realized gain/loss on options delivered/received in kind separately (as in-kind realized), measured against identified cost at the valuation price used.
requirements.quote: Amount is included in realized gain/(loss) in-kind on the Statements of Operations.

requirements.text: The system must adjust the number of contracts and strike of each option for reference-ETF corporate actions (splits) as adjusted by the OCC, and must apply the contract adjustment and the price adjustment together so position value is unchanged by the split itself.
requirements.assumption_or_question: The documents do not state how option terms adjust for a reference-ETF split; assumed OCC standard adjustment (strike divided, contracts multiplied by split ratio). The exact OCC adjustment method must be confirmed with the clearing broker.

requirements.text: Because the Fund holds FLEX Options on a price-return basis, the system must not accrue reference-ETF dividend income to the Fund; reference ex-dividend events affect the Fund only through the model prices of the options.
requirements.quote: the Cap and Buffer will be provided on a price return basis... the Fund will not receive the benefit of any dividends.

requirements.text: The NAV-error correction threshold at which a day's NAV must be reprocessed must be obtained; the documents do not state a tolerance.
requirements.assumption_or_question: Ask the client/administrator for the NAV error-correction policy threshold (commonly $0.01 per share and/or 0.50% of NAV). No figure is given absent that policy.
